about_the_game:
Navigate a Deadly Battle Royal

Dive into Salem's world as he embarks on a perilous "Sundown" survival competition. Your choices forge his identity as he navigates treacherous waters with James - his secret lover who risks everything to be by his side. Will you prioritize duty to the regime or protect your forbidden relationship? Every decision deepens Salem's internal conflict.

Character Dynamics in Action

See how characters remember and react to your choices throughout the demo. Help Audrey out and she might become an ally. Show hostility, and watch relationships deteriorate. When the clock starts ticking during ambushes and confrontations, your split-second choices determine who survives and how. The demo showcases the high-stakes decision-making that defines the full experience.

Enter a World of Secrets

Experience a solarpunk dystopia where privileged citizens like Salem enjoy status while others hide their true identities to survive. The demo introduces you to the Storm Oak camp—a militaristic youth program where conformity is enforced and questioning authority can be fatal. Discover mysterious symbols and coded conversations that suggest the world isn't what it seems.

Why You'll Love the Rottenroots Demo

  • Test our unique personality system that tracks traits like boldness, reliability, and insight—shaped by your choices and affecting how others perceive Salem.

  • Experience multiple paths through the demo's river journey, each revealing different aspects of the world and characters.

  • Get your first glimpse of Laura Meggers' distinctive art style that brings Salem's world to life through hand-drawn characters and atmospheric environments.

  • Enjoy 45-60 minutes of gameplay that drops you right into the action—set during the first third of the full game's story.

  • Replay the demo to uncover alternate routes, different character interactions, and hidden secrets that change with each playthrough—revealing new layers of the story with every decision.

Download the Demo Now!

short_description: Navigate treacherous waters in this stylized visual novel with deep roleplaying. Shape Salem's personality through time-pressured choices as he battles for survival while hiding a forbidden romance. Every decision transforms both his fate and identity. What will you choose?
